engines._note: build: codex | claude. review must differ from build. Codex runs through the build-codex skill.

budget._note: Stop hook warns when one session passes this many million tokens (input incl. cache + output).

post_edit._note: Commands for the file just edited, {file} = its path. Empty = off. Set by the conventions skill, e.g. format: "npx biome format --write {file}", lint: "npx eslint {file}".

ui._note: quick: one direction on the chosen design system + moodboard, 1 critique round. full: 3 directions, 2 critique rounds, optional v0 exploration, visual regression baselines.
